items.t: Timing chain guides break on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $1,000-2,000 when caught early. A snapped chain usually means a replacement engine.

items.t: Electric water pump or thermostat fails and the engine overheats
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $400 for an OEM pump plus a similar amount for installation.

items.t: Valve cover gasket leaks oil or the plastic cover cracks
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about an hour of labor for the gasket and about $500 for a new OEM cover.

items.t: Crankcase vent valve fails and the engine whistles
items.job: Replace valve cover with built-in vent valve

items.t: Oil filter housing gasket leaks oil
items.note: The gasket is cheap; a cracked housing costs several hundred dollars more.

items.t: Plastic turbo charge pipe cracks and power drops
items.note: Enginepatrol cites $200-400 for an OEM or aftermarket pipe.

items.t: Plastic coolant hoses and expansion tank crack and leak
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank and hose

items.t: VANOS solenoid fault causes rough running
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $150 per solenoid plus a few hundred dollars of labor.

items.t: M4 crank hub can spin and knock timing out
items.job: Replace crank hub and reset timing
items.note: Enginepatrol cites about $2,000 if caught before engine damage.
